QuestInfo.name: The Shadow Knight's Letter
QuestInfo.0: You wonder how #p2090004# will take the contents of the #t4220151# now that it's restored. You should talk to #b#p2090004##k in #b#m250000000##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2090004# wants you to bring a #t4220151# to #b#p2091007##k. As Mr. Do told you, find the way to the Back Alley of Mu Lung Dojo from and see Mu Gong. You can enter Mu Lung Dojo via the Mu Lung Dojo Bulletin Board in towns. 

Head to the #rMu Lung Dojo Bulletin Board#k in #m250000100#. As Mr. Do suggested, you should take a close look at the #bgreen flag#k near the Mu Lung Dojo Entrance.
QuestInfo.2: You met #p2091007# and handed him\n#o9300351#'s letter of warning.

npc.0: You still haven't headed out to meet #p2091007# yet? I told you that you can find the back alley that leads to the top near the green flag behind the Mu Lung Dojo Entrance! Hurry!

item.0: Hmmm? How did you end up here? You don't look like you belong up here yet. You'll need to follow the proper procedure of this training center and move up from the very bottom.
